connectors.name: AniWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: Adds German Dub (Deutsch audio) through the AniWorld Vidmoly mirror; episodes are tagged Sub and/or Dub from AniWorld's per-episode language flags. Sub keeps the German-subtitle mirror first with English-subtitle fallback. Home/Browse discovery, search and details are unchanged. Visible captions, spoken language and offline remain unverified on device.
